name: Fang Fungus Cage

source.title: Pathfinder #212: A Voice in the Blight

stealth.details: (master) to realize the fungus will harm its prisoner if it is tampered with; noticing the fungus itself has a DC of 0

disable: DC 41 Nature check three times to delicately cut the elf free without causing the fungus to react, or DC 47 Medicine check two times to gently manipulate the fungus loose from where it's tendrils have penetrated flesh, or DC 50 Athletics check to swiftly wrench the elf free from the cage before the fungus can react
reset: A fang fungus cage resets instantly.

items.name: Rasp Elf
items.text:
Trigger A fungus cage takes damage, or any magical effect targets a caged elf

---
Effect The tendrils constricting and growing through an elf swiftly lash, constrict, and burrow deep. An Unconscious elf is killed by this, while a conscious elf is rendered unconscious.

text: A mass of hundreds of long thin fang-shaped fungal growths protruding from the wall encase and pierce the flesh of an elven prisoner.
